records.text: An authenticated anonymous source reported that Ben Shapiro was allegedly with Gary Javitch and an unidentified woman when Charlie Kirk was shot
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep amqTMimDr0A)

appearances.snippet: Regardless, I will still say allegedly because, of course, there was always room for misunderstanding. ... But the person that Ben (Ben Shapiro) was with has allegedly told various other people that he was with Ben (Ben Shapiro) when Charlie Kirk was shot. ... Now, we were not able to confirm that they were at breakfast or lunch. Only what came to us was that they were together. ... And that person is a man named Gary Javitch. Ben (Ben Shapiro) was allegedly with Gary Javitch and an as-of-yet unidentified woman when Charlie Kirk was shot.

verification.notes: The transcript says Owens's team authenticated an anonymous tipster but repeatedly qualifies the identification of Gary Javitch and an unidentified woman as alleged. Current searches found reporting that repeats Owens's claim but no primary record or independent witness corroborating the meeting. The anonymous source and claimed authentication cannot be independently assessed.
